# Zoom App Marketplace

A marketplace or store: it needs a built artifact (extension, app, plugin) plus a review process.

## Steps
1. This needs a built artifact or a business process (App Store / Marketplace). Don't attempt it automatically.
2. If it fits the product (e.g. a browser extension for the Chrome Web Store), add it to the wrap-up as a suggestion for the user.

## Make the listing perform
- Manual by default. Suggest it to the user only if they ship that kind of artifact.
